shortDescription: Nepal issued a fresh warning after water levels rose in a key river, threatening to disrupt rescue efforts following catastrophic flooding that killed hundreds and left thousands missing along its border with China, according to Bloomberg.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Nepal Warns of More Flooding as Rescue Work Faces Disruption
